name: open-design-points
body:
Open design points for the plan (do NOT invent decisions here; those pinned are marked DECIDED).

(1) Per-language incremental granularity and the meaning of "signature" for early cutoff. Python's granularity is DECIDED as per-package/module (requirements.note.python-frontend-open-points #5; requirements.requirement.python-incremental-contract): the target set is a set of modules/packages, resolution still runs against the full `ty` project. The remaining per-language granularities (crate/package for Rust/Go/Java/TS/C#) and what "signature" means for early cutoff remain plan-time.

(2) Where the shared content-addressed fact store lives and how worktrees/DBs project from it — plan-time.

(3) The DB splice mechanism (seed-from-previous vs overlay) and its atomicity — plan-time (domain.note.cache-store-and-splice).

(4) Re-anchor/fallback thresholds — purely correctness/version gates, never heuristics; plan-time.
